cwe.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

real_world_analog.summary: OS command injection in an Edimax router diagnostic page: the host parameter reached a shell command by string building (CWE-78).
real_world_analog.fix: Pass the host as an argument without a shell and validate its shape; this case uses an equivalent containment (argument vector without a shell, plus shape check).
real_world_analog.verification: CVE number and summary confirmed via web search on 2026-11-01; the app in this case is original synthetic code.

note: Self-contained oracle case. Proven directly with effect='canary_exec'. No upstream repo/commit applies because the code is original synthetic code written for this case.
license: Original code written for Exhibit A; no third-party code vendored (see README.md).

bypass.expectation: proven against fixed_incomplete: the newline smuggles a second command past a screen that only rejects `;`, `&` and `|`; the incomplete fix must not be accepted as fixed.
